actions_and_outcomes: All eight spells pay their ordinary printed costs; Spider pays its green hybrid option. Scenario fixture mana is explicitly supplied separately from the natural-game group.

Ka-Zar enters with exact legendary Zabu; Mole enables an ordinary graveyard land play from an explicitly bounded Forest graveyard fixture. That land and Restorative searched tapped Forest produce Moloids and Zabu counters.
Opponent actually casts and pays Murder on Human Torch. Paid flash Nurse returns the just-died permanent to hand with checked target announcement; Torch is then paid again.

Restorative self-player plus Zabu targets, one extra actual generic mana pays Speed triggered optional cost, and the later child targets haste Speed. Search completes normally, adding a tapped basic and landfall counter/token, then Restorative adds its targeted counter.

Spider accepts the actual exact-source tap, then the separately announced child protects current nonattacking Speed. Paid late Avengers supplies its Hero lord and sees prior Hero entry/attack for end-step draw; Human Torch observes those actual draws.
Speed attacks with haste; nonhaste Bear cannot block due to the resolved restriction. On next own turn both temporary restriction and indestructibility expire.
Ka-Zar permits a real library-top Forest play after ordinary turn advance and draws; top is owner-visible and opponent-hidden. New landfall creates the third Moloid and fourth Zabu counter.

Paid Arc Reactor uses five real mana rather than improvise helpers, enters tapped, adds one other artifact to Iron Man power, and enables the real attack-history draw. A Moloid attacks and accepts one actual mill; Nurse attacks and gains four life via lifelink with the Hero lord.
Further ordinary army combat reaches a natural Winner for each seat without concession or injected life/outcome.
